title: Add benchmark workflow: run on main, comment results on PR
description:
Add .github/workflows/bench.yml: triggered on push to main and manually. Runs criterion benchmarks, saves results as a GitHub Actions artifact. On PR: uses benchcmp or critcmp to compare PR results against main baseline and posts a comment with the delta. Artifact: .github/workflows/bench.yml.

Acceptance: benchmark results posted as PR comment; >10% regression fails the check; new benchmarks are noted as 'no baseline'
